policy: Dated CANCELLED notices apply to their affected event date unless an earlier effective_from is provided. BOOKING_FULL notices may surface from effective_from in news/homepage-news contexts; detail_visible_from can delay generic place-page banners, while day-of operational surfaces stay scoped to the affected date. Ongoing SUSPENDED/SUSPENDED_UPGRADE notices remain active until a later operational update clears them.
